column10: Identifies the type of acknowledged request.
Identifies a message by a unique identifier and the date and time when the message was created by the sender.

Identifies a process by a unique identifier and the date and time when the first message belonging to the process was created by the sender. The process identification remains the same in all messages belonging to the same process, from the initial request message to the final account report closing the process.
Reference to the message that is acknowledged.
Status of the request.

column7: Reports to a corporate on the actual set-up of the account, related services and mandates.

column10: Characteristics of the account.

Account contract established between the organisation or the group to which the organisation belongs, and the account servicer. This contract has to be applied for the new account to be opened and maintained.
Specifies target and actual dates.
Information specifying the account mandate.
Definition of a group of parties.
Unique and unambiguous identification of the account used as a reference for the opening of another account.
Unique and unambiguous identification of the account where to transfer the balance.
Identification of the transfer account servicer.
Identification of the account.
Name of the account. It provides an additional means of identification, and is designated by the account servicer in agreement with the account owner.
Specifies the current state of an account, eg, enabled or deleted.
Type of the account.
Medium of exchange of value.
Monthly average of the payment amounts (that is, payments going out) over a year.
Monthly average of the received amounts over a year (that is, payments coming in).
Monthly average of the number of payments (coming in and going out) over a year.
Sum of the end of day balances over a month divided by the number of business days in the month.
Specifies the purpose of the account.
Specifies the value of the balance under which a notification will be sent to the account owner.
Specifies the value of the balance above which a notification will be sent to the account owner.
Specifies how often statements (for audit purposes) will be sent, in which format, to which address.
Date when the account will be or was closed.
Restriction on capability or operations allowed.

column7: Specifies target and actual dates dates related to account opening and closing.

column10: Date on which the account and related basic services are expected to be operational for the account owner.
Date on which the account and related services are expected to cease to be operational for the account owner.
Date on which the account and related basic services are effectively operational for the account owner.
Date on which the account and related services cease effectively to be operational for the account owner.

Indicator that the account opening/maintenance/closing process needs to be treated urgently, that is, sooner than the terms established by the service level agreed between the account holder customer and the account servicing institution.
Indicates removal of the account. After removal, an account will not appear anymore in reports.
